title: Tax preparation and accounting

basis.cite: Internal Revenue Code 7216 and Treas. Reg. 301.7216-1 to -3
basis.summary: Preparers may not disclose or use tax return information without consent. This covers ALL return information, not only identifiers.

basis.cite: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, 15 U.S.C. 6801-6809; FTC Safeguards Rule, 16 CFR Part 314
basis.summary: Protects customers' nonpublic personal information held by financial institutions, which includes tax preparers.
Safeguarding taxpayer data: practical security guidance for preparers.

identifiers.treatment: birth dates: year only; other dates optional

caveats: Section 7216 protects the figures themselves (income, deductions). Removing identifiers does not by itself make a disclosure permitted.
Dollar amounts are left in place; combined with an employer name they can identify a taxpayer.
note: A starting point drawn from the cited texts, not legal advice. Have counsel confirm the list for your jurisdiction and use before relying on it.
